title: Road-verge grass composition and theoretical BMP reference observations
authors: Aaron E. Brown; Judith S. Ford; Catherine S. E. Bale; Miller A. Camargo-Valero; Nick J. Cheffins; Patrick E. Mason; Andrew M. Price-Allison; Andrew B. Ross; Peter G. Taylor
material_scope: Fresh verge grass and verge grass ensiled for four months; sampled in 2016
uncertainty_note: Composition values are transcribed with the source's printed ± values. The Table 3 note does not identify the statistic for those composition values. Theoretical BMP standard deviations are reported across 9 fresh and 7 ensiled sampling sites.
limitations: Not GreenHub or Dutch VARTA grass; composition is reference-only.
Theoretical Buswell and Boyle methane potentials assume complete biodegradation and are not measured BMP or continuous-reactor yields.
Oxygen analytical or difference-calculation basis is not identified in the table note.
Ensiled sulfur is reported ND; it is retained as censored/missing, not zero.
Four-month bale ensiling is not equivalent to GreenHub loose-feed storage or a validated kinetic model.
redistribution_note: Contains limited attributed numeric data and metadata; the publication is CC BY 4.0.
